title: Geologic map of North America [GIS data]
citation: Reed, J.C., Wheeler, J.O., Tucholke, B.E., Card, K.D., Davidson, A., Hoffman, P.F., Okulitch, A.V., Palmer, A.R., Sanford, B.V., Williams, G.K., Williams, H., Dixon, J., Embry, A.F., Holcombe, T.L., Laine, E.P., Mountain, G.S., Popenoe, P., and Wiley, T., 2005, Geologic map of North America: Geological Society of America Continent-Scale Map 001, map scale 1:5,000,000.
notes:
Continent-scale map (1:5,000,000); all four pages are OCR of map sheets and are heavily garbled. Pages 1, 3 and 4 are map faces with almost no legible text; only the explanation on page 2 and the suggested references were read. Recorded only legible items relevant to South Carolina: the Triassic-Jurassic mafic dike unit of the Appalachian Piedmont and Blue Ridge, and the Eocene group names in the Coastal Plain correlation column. The age of each Eocene group is read from the adjacent legend line and is flagged inferred because OCR split the legend boxes. Map symbol 'RJm' is as OCR'd (the Triassic-Jurassic age symbol is likely misread). Impact-structure table, Canadian dikes, seafloor units and line-symbol definitions skipped (outside SC or unreadable). Self-referencing 'suggested forms of reference' for Canada and the combined map skipped.
